description: This file declares utility functions for time management across different platforms, including fetching current time, converting between formats, and checking system time validity.
external_methods: timespecDiff(struct timespec*, struct timespec*, struct timespec*)
timespecAdd(struct timespec*, struct timespec*, struct timespec*)

methods.name: supportMonotonic
methods.description: Checks if the current platform supports a monotonic clock.

methods.name: getCurrentTime
methods.description: Retrieves the current time with platform-specific mechanisms, populating a timespec struct.

methods.name: getCurrentTime_t
methods.description: Returns the current time as a time_t value.

methods.name: convertTimespecToTime_t
methods.description: Converts a timespec to a time_t.

methods.name: convertTimespecToUnixTimeMillis
methods.description: Converts a timespec to milliseconds since epoch.

methods.name: convertUnixTimeMillisToTimespec
methods.description: Converts milliseconds since epoch to a timespec.

methods.name: convertUnixTimeMillisToTime_t
methods.description: Converts milliseconds since epoch to time_t.

methods.name: convertTime_tToUnixTimeMillis
methods.description: Converts a time_t to milliseconds since epoch.

methods.name: timespecDiff
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two timespec instances.

methods.name: getCurrentUnixTimeMillis
methods.description: Returns the current system timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

methods.name: getMonotonicMillis
methods.description: Returns the milliseconds elapsed on a monotonic clock.

methods.name: unixTimeMillisToISO8601
methods.description: Converts milliseconds since epoch to ISO8601 formatted string.

methods.name: isSystemTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the system time appears valid (e.g., not set to a value close to Unix epoch).
